summary: Model Eval Runner: access denied after identity migration — SCIM 'accountVerified' false prevents RBAC grant
description:
Issue summary:
Users in the model-eval-runner group are receiving 403 when attempting to start evaluation jobs after last week's identity migration. Investigation shows SCIM profiles created/updated by the migration have 'accountVerified': false for affected users. RBAC policy for model-eval-runner explicitly requires verified accounts.

Impact:
- 8+ internal users (platform and research) cannot start model evaluation runs in prod us-west.
- Blocked telemetry and nightly evals; some scheduled CI jobs fail with 403 causing alert churn.
- Affects developer velocity for model-quality investigations.

Environment:
- prod (us-west) — Console and runner service behind internal SSO.
- Affected identities were created via bulk SCIM migration job 'scim-migration-2026-03-08'.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Try to open https://console.redwood.internal/model-evals and trigger a new evaluation run.
2) Request is authenticated via Okta SSO, then SCIM profile is queried for 'accountVerified'.
3) RBAC service denies grant due to accountVerified==false, resulting in 403.

Observed logs / evidence:
- authz proxy (authz-proxy-2a) logs 2026-03-12T09:42:11Z: "grant denied: accountVerified=false, required=true; principal=U12345"
- SCIM sync job logs show bulk_create with patch property 'accountVerified=false' for new identities (scim-migration-2026-03-08)
- Okta profile for user shows emailVerified=true but internal SCIM object has accountVerified=false (mismatch).
- Related incidents: INT-314159 (relaystate/ttl mismatch) referenced because that incident changed SCIM sync timing.

Hypothesis:
- Migration code path sets accountVerified conservatively to false when it cannot confirm verification timestamp from Okta attribute mapping. A recent Okta attribute name change (email_verified -> isEmailVerified) during the migration led to fallback value false for many users. RBAC policy was tightened in February to require accountVerified=true for any console/eval-runner grants.

Immediate customer-visible workaround:
- Manual override: run 'id-sync fix-verify U12345' to flip accountVerified to true for critical users (devops oncall has used this to restore a small set).
- Temporary RBAC mitigation: relax model-eval-runner policy to accept accountVerified==false for 72 hours (requires change control and risk approval).

Suggested next steps / owner:
- Identity team to audit scim-migration-2026-03-08 code path and patch attribute mapping (owner: Priya Nair).
- Patch applied to scim-sync to copy Okta's isEmailVerified -> accountVerified and rerun migration fixes for affected users.
- Run a dry-run script to list identities with accountVerified=false and cross-check against Okta emailVerified attribute.
- Consider short-term RBAC policy toggle and then revert after migration fix.
comments: 2026-03-12 Sofia Park: Reported by research eng. First triage showed ~8 affected users; escalated to identity team. Included authz-proxy logs and sample user U12345. Marking as P2 since core infra blocked for a small number of engineers.

2026-03-12 Priya Nair: Acknowledged. I can reproduce using a dev identity copied via the migration job. Adding scim-sync and okta teams to investigate attribute mapping. Setting short-term mitigation plan: manual 'id-sync fix-verify' for oncall and list of critical users.

2026-03-13 Alex Gomez (SRE): Ran a query in production: 74 identities have accountVerified=false in roster and are members of model-eval-runner group. Patching the migration script to prefer 'isEmailVerified' if present; creating a backfill job. Will need scheduled window to run backfill (low risk but touches identity store).

2026-03-13 Security (Elena Ruiz): Note — any RBAC relaxation must be approved by security. Recommend targeted manual fixes for named users rather than broad policy relax unless emergency declared. Open to rapid exception for 72 hours if change control approved.

2026-03-14 Priya Nair: Patch merged: github.com/redwood-inference/identity-sync/commit/9f3b2d7. Backfill job prepared as 'scim-backfill-accountVerified-2026-03-14' to set accountVerified=true where Okta attribute indicates verified. Scheduling backfill for 2026-03-15 03:00 UTC. Will monitor authz logs and evaluation runner success metrics.
resolution_notes: Patch added to SCIM mapper to read both 'isEmailVerified' and 'email_verified' attributes from Okta. Backfill job executed 2026-03-15; post-run verification shows 72/74 previously-unverified accounts now true. Two accounts required manual email re-verification with owners. No RBAC policy changes were applied after security recommended manual fixes. Monitoring for 48h — no further 403s reported from model-eval-runner. Follow-up: add unit test for SCIM attribute fallbacks and a migration preflight checklist.
follow_up_tasks: Create automated preflight check for SCIM migrations
Add unit test to scim-sync for attribute fallback
Confluence: document migration checklist and owner sign-off
